title: a crossing through the ticket machine or sail also commits the ticket's commons state file, path-limited, so it is not left dirty
intention: Ticket.passed, Ticket.failed and the sail crossing commit the ticket's commons state.json, path-limited, in the same act as the component's history.json and state.json.
why: Measured: 2026-11-19, read by cc_0 and confirmed by git show on origin: crossings 1648858dd (633a76c125d2) and 89447c4a6 (c408f2c1e66d), both DROPPED, committed only .artifact-journal.jsonl and cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/{history,state}.json; the two tickets' commons state files stayed dirty until a hand commit, commons 0595ae5b3 ('633a76c125d2, c408f2c1e66d: DROPPED'). The ticket machine's published helper commit_crossing_records (ticket 79875eb17ac2, on its stacked branch, not yet landed) path-limits to the component's two files in the class-space repo only; the ticket's charter public_interface lists only Ticket and GATE_HOLDER.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured); Law 5 (the repo is the state of the machine: a crossing's record is committed where it lands); Law 9 (green is earned).
how: A hypothesis, not a settled shape: the public_interface is the class Ticket, so the commons commit belongs inside Ticket.passed and Ticket.failed beside the existing commit_crossing_records call, not a new public function. Either commit_crossing_records takes an optional commons_state path and commits it in the commons repo (a second path-limited git -C of the commons work tree), or a private sibling _commit_commons_state does and both run from the same call sites. Choose by the charter: a sibling stays private and needs no public_interface change. The commons commit stays path-limited (the ticket's state file and the artifact journal line it moved) and never stages another ticket's dirt. Depends on 79875eb17ac2, 2955a4a316d3 and ee9637b02525 landing first.

clauses.claim: after Ticket.passed or Ticket.failed on a ticket whose commons state file is tracked, git status --porcelain in the commons shows that state file clean, and a commit in the commons names it
another ticket's dirty file in the same commons work tree is not staged or committed by the crossing
a crossing whose ticket sits in no git work tree (a scratch commons) returns without raising

decisions.text: D1: Ticket.passed, Ticket.failed and the sail crossing commit the ticket's commons state.json, path-limited, in the same act as the component's history.json and state.json.
D2: the red-first proof, one tooth per clause.
